subject: Pilot economics and 1M-token target — next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & $/1M target

Hi Liam — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and two asks so we can lock in the right pilot configuration: 

Recap (from our 45-minute call)
- Northbridge will pilot a user-facing summarization workflow for two product lines (support and account insights).
- Expected initial soft-launch footprint: short-term ~3–5M tokens/month, with a target ramp to ~9–12M tokens/month over Q4 if latency and cost look good.
- Key buyer criteria: unit economics (target $/1M tokens) and predictable latency under 350ms p50 for the production path.

Asks
1) Can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly token window you want us to price against? (range or single target is fine).
2) What is your internal target price per 1M tokens (ballpark range) that would make the pilot convert to a paid rollout? You mentioned wanting to be under a certain threshold — can you reconfirm?

Proposal items I mentioned on the call (attached estimate):
- We can size a pilot configuration and show two unit-econ buckets: hosted pay-as-you-go (~$1,350 / 1M tokens for the recommended model) vs. reserved/commit pricing (can go down to ~$900 / 1M with a 3mo commit).
- Short credit top-up for pilot: we typically approve one-time trial credits to cover initial ramp; we discussed ~200k tokens as a request.

I attached a short usage estimate (pilot-usage-estimate.xlsx) that maps token volumes -> expected monthly cost across both pricing profiles. If you can confirm the volume window and your $/1M target range, I’ll get a formal credit approval routed and draft a mutual action plan.

Next steps suggested
- Liam confirms token range + target $/1M by end of day Tuesday
- I’ll route credit approval and send MAP link + a brief intro to our solutions engineer to scope latency testing

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

Attachment: pilot-usage-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northbridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@northbridge.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:01:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & $/1M target

Thanks Jonas — great session. Confirming the expected profile:
- Soft launch (first 6 weeks): ~3.2M tokens/month (predominantly output tokens from long-form summaries).
- Target steady-state (post-launch, Q4 ramp): 9–11M tokens/month.

On unit economics: our procurement bar for a PLG-style pilot to convert is if we can get to roughly $1,000–$1,200 / 1M tokens. If the production path stays above $1,400 / 1M, the finance team will need a stronger ROI case and a multi-quarter commit.

We do need a short extension on trial credits — can you authorize a 30-day top-up for ~200k tokens to cover Q4 smoke tests? Contracts is looped on the budget side in case we need an MSA amendment.

Liam
Director, Product — Northbridge AI
liam.oconnor@northbridge.ai | +1 917-555-2219

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, contracts@northbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:14:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & $/1M target

Liam — thanks for the clarity, this helps a lot. Quick responses and what we can do today: 

1) Pilot credit: Approved — one-time top-up of 200,000 tokens credited to your trial account. I’ve attached an approval stub (redwood-trial-credits-approval.pdf) that our billing team will use to apply the credit. Conditions: credit is usable only for the pilot project named in the MAP and expires 45 days after issuance.

2) Pricing guidance:
- Recommended (hosted, no commit): $1,350 / 1M tokens for the model we demoed (this reflects our current verified perf/cost profile).
- Commit path: with a 3-month minimum committed spend, we can offer $900 / 1M tokens for the same throughput profile (this requires a brief capacity reservation and a short addendum to the order).
- If your finance target is $1,000–$1,200 / 1M, we can work the MAP to include a tiered step-down as volume ramps; I’ll loop Solutions to validate latency at target throughput so we can lock the commitment terms.

3) Next steps (I’ll take action today):
- Jonas: will create the MAP and send a HubSpot link.
- Marissa: routing the credit approval to billing (attaching the approval stub).
- Ben: solutions engineer intro to scope p50/p95 latency and test plan (Jonas — can you confirm a 60-minute slot later this week?).

Yes, we can do the 30-day extension via the 45-day credit window above. If Northbridge is comfortable with the commit path, we’ll outline the timeline to hit $900 / 1M.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-trial-credits-approval.pdf (approval stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northbridge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, contracts@northbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & $/1M target

Perfect, thanks Marissa — the credit top-up and the 45-day window works for us. I’ll accept the MAP when Jonas sends it and loop the engineering lead for the SE session.

We’ll aim to start the soft launch the following week and track burn against the estimate you attached.

— Liam
